The '''Xamster language''' was the native tongue of the [[Xamster/Legends|Xamster]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Xagobah/Legends|Xagobah]]. Its sounds were predominately sharp clicks and guttural growls.<ref name="ANT 10">''[[Boba Fett: A New Threat]]'', Chapter 10.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Although the Xamster [[Xeran]] speaks his language in the novel ''[[Boba Fett: A New Threat]]'', the language is only described, never officially named, in that source.<ref name="ANT 10" />
